hash_rule: SHA256(UTF-8 canonical JSON of definition with recursively sorted keys, compact separators, and one trailing LF)

definition.source_type: public GitHub issues with exactly one same-repository merged resolving PR
eligibility_filters: issue is public and contains a task-facing problem/request independent of the resolving PR
resolving PR merged after issue creation and before benchmark package first commit
reconstructable pre-fix base exists and can be exported history-free without any fix commit
task can be executed and verified offline after frozen dependency/image preparation
no private credentials, destructive external side effects, unsafe/illegal action, or unavailable proprietary dependency
resolution patch is <=12 files and <=800 changed lines excluding lock/vendor/generated files
resolution is not primarily benchmark/test-harness-for-this-benchmark content
task-facing sources can be separated from linked PR, final patch, resolution comments, and answer-bearing provenance

complexity_rule.straightforward: resolving patch <=2 files and <=80 changed lines
complexity_rule.medium: resolving patch <=6 files and <=300 changed lines and not straightforward
complexity_rule.complex: resolving patch <=12 files and <=800 changed lines and not medium/straightforward
